items.item_text: Experience recognizing, identifying, and responding to problems/errors with reimbursements, invoices, and financial transactions.
Experience with AggieExpense, PrePurchasing, and Aggie Enterprise.
Experience using organizational and time management skills to prioritize and coordinate multiple complex and detailed projects simultaneously.
Experience in reviewing, understanding, and applying travel and entertainment policies and procedures.
Administrative support experience in a professional, front office environment.
Interpersonal and communication skills to communicate effectively with staff, faculty, administrators, and students across a diverse range of backgrounds, experiences, and identities.

Under general supervision from the Business Operations Manager, provide administrative program support for DSS Yellow Cluster as well as for the centers and programs that the unit supports. Assist in day-to-day operations. Respond to general inquires in person, by email, or on the phone. Serve as the main point of contact for purchasing and reimbursement for Philosophy and Science & Technology Studies. Responsible for running errands to campus and in town. Supervise and direct business office student assistants.

This position is the facilities manager for our on-campus units and is the primary contact for placing work orders & reporting building issues, working w/ Special Services, Facilities, Lock Shop, Janitorial Services & other campus units.

Under general guidance of the Undergraduate Programs Supervisor, provide programmatic support for majors and minors housed within the Yellow Cluster. Serve as the point-person for quarterly course scheduling, assist with the PTA process, and help manage the advising appointment calendar systems.

Provide support as needed to the cluster Department Chairs, Chief Administrative Officer, Undergraduate Programs Supervisor, and Business Operations Manager. Act as primary backup to Yellow Cluster Events Coordinator and provide administrative backup to other Yellow Cluster business office units and advisors.
Demonstrated commitment to fostering teamwork, collaboration, and mutual respect in a working and learning environment.
